title: 第15章 原来饭菜还可以这样吃第16章 可以带人
slug: 不过是穿梭万界为啥都管我叫爹
content_zh:
在目前这个时代大多数人仍旧保留着直接用双手抓取食物的习惯，更不用说什么专门的工具或器具。
即便是天上的仙人们也是这样随意地用餐。
比如眼前正在享受美味佳肴且形象全无损的大佬就是个典型案例：一顿简单的饭局竟能让她这般失态。
“稍等一会儿就好了。”
还没等后土彻底反应过来，童元安已经起身向着附近一处竹林方向走去。
他是那种说干就干的人，在他眼中没有完不成的任务。
正如当初仅仅因为一个道歉事件便毅然决然辞去全国五十强公司职务时所表现出的决心一般强大有力。
“咚咚咚...”
走进竹林深处找到最合适的地方后停下来开始了工作。
利用这里的竹子制成的餐具将远超未来几千年水平。
不仅坚固耐用而且自带一股令人心旷神怡的独特香气，定能让使用者感到前所未有的美好体验。
只见一柄闪耀着光芒的长剑迅速穿行于茂密枝叶间，“噌噌噌”
地飞速砍斫着...
这件宝物绝非凡品能够媲美，其本身已具备自我意识，可以完全根据操作者的意图精准切割无需二次加工处理即可使用。
没过多久各式各样的小件依次成型:
筷子、汤匙、叉子...
由竹子打造而成的全新进食用具正式亮相了！
霎时天地间似乎传来阵阵共鸣，空中再度飘荡起金色云朵——这是获得巨大功德象征的表现之一。
见此情景后土只淡淡瞟了一眼，并未表现太多吃惊表情。
对她而言这样的事情早已习以为常：

任何一个突发奇想都有可能催生出前所未有的奇妙发明；
每一件崭新产物背后往往伴随着意想不到的奖励。
如此奇特的现象即使是在漫长的生命历程当中也难得见到几次...
“发什么愣呀，快来看看我的新品吧。”
吸满能量后的童元安兴奋地捧着手里的成品回到人群之中。
刚好村民们结束了早晨锻炼活动正好碰上这突如其来的神奇场面。
于是众人立刻围拢上来争相欣赏这位天才带来最新杰作。
“哎呦我去，这家伙手里拿的是啥东东啊，看着真精致！”
我看像是用来防身自卫用具吧？你们瞧瞧这些家伙事儿多么小巧锋利正适合近身攻击呢！”
“简直是瞎扯淡嘛!这么个小玩意怎么可能对付得了强悍妖兽?
……
周围人七嘴八舌议论纷纷各自提出种种离谱猜测，惹得童元安一阵无奈只好赶紧制止住混乱场面。
别猜了各位亲，准备开饭就知道这些东西具体有什么用了哦!
说着他就随手捞起一串刚刚烤好的鲜嫩肉串放进竹制大盘内展示给大家看。
大家可以轮流试用感受下效果哦.
随后邀请身边几个人上前逐一尝试新用具.
起初几位村民显得笨手笨脚不太习惯，在童元安耐心指导下逐渐熟悉并发出赞叹之声:
content_en:
In this era, most people still retain the habit of grabbing food directly with their hands, let alone any special tools or utensils.
Even the immortals in heaven eat their meals casually.
For example, the boss who was enjoying a delicious meal in front of her without losing her image was a typical case: a simple meal could make her lose her composure like this.
"Just wait a little bit."
Before Hou Tu could fully react, Tong Yuanan had already stood up and walked toward a nearby bamboo forest.
He is the kind of person who does what he says, and there is no task that cannot be completed in his eyes.
Just like the determination he showed when he resolutely resigned from one of the top 50 companies in the country just because of an apology incident.
"Dong dong dong..."
After walking deep into the bamboo forest to find the most suitable place, I stopped and started working.
Tableware made from the bamboo here will be far better than what will be available in the next few thousand years.
Not only is it sturdy and durable, but it also has a unique and refreshing aroma, which will surely give users an unprecedented wonderful experience.
I saw a shining long sword quickly passing through the dense branches and leaves, "噌噌噌"
The ground was chopping rapidly...
This treasure is unparalleled in comparison to other masterpieces. It is already self-aware and can be precisely cut according to the operator's intention and used without the need for secondary processing.
It didn’t take long for various small pieces to take shape:
Chopsticks, spoons, forks...
The new eating utensils made of bamboo are officially unveiled!
Suddenly, there seemed to be resonances between heaven and earth, and golden clouds floated in the sky again - this is one of the manifestations of obtaining huge merits.
After seeing this scene, Tu only glanced at it lightly and did not show much surprise.
For her, this kind of thing has long been accustomed to:
Any sudden idea may lead to unprecedented wonderful inventions;
Behind every new product is often an unexpected reward.
Such a strange phenomenon is rarely seen several times even in a long life...
"Why are you so stunned? Come and see my new products."
After absorbing the energy, Tong Yuanan excitedly returned to the crowd holding the finished product in his hand.
Just as the villagers had finished their morning exercise, this sudden magical scene happened.
So everyone immediately gathered around to admire the latest masterpiece brought by this genius.
"Hey, let me go, what is this guy holding in his hand? It looks so exquisite!"
I think it's a self-defense tool, right? Look at how small and sharp these guys are, perfect for close attacks! "
"This is nonsense! How can such a gadget be able to deal with powerful monsters?
…
People around him were talking and making all kinds of outrageous speculations, which made Tong Yuanan helpless and had to quickly stop the chaos.
Don’t guess, dear friends, you’ll know exactly what these things are used for when you’re ready to eat!
As he spoke, he picked up a skewer of freshly grilled tender meat and put it on a large bamboo plate to show it to everyone.
Everyone can take turns to try it out and feel the effect.
Then invite a few people around you to come forward and try the new tools one by one.
At first, several villagers seemed clumsy and not used to it, but under Tong Yuanan's patient guidance, they gradually became familiar with it and expressed their admiration:
